title: Active Matter
description:
Join dangerous raids for loot or intense PvP battles in this SCP-inspired realistic hardcore tactical shooter set in a fractured multiverse. Fight in the quantum unstable zones over control of the active matter - the substance that bends time and space.

You’re an operative stuck in a time loop, always brought back from the dead to the same point. Choose your loadout and enter quantum unstable zones rich with active matter - the most valuable and the most dangerous resource in all multiverse. Fight against rivals from other timelines, survive physics-breaking anomalies and try to stay alive.

Harvest active matter, gather loot and extract to a safe place before the whole zone ceases to exist with everything inside it.
